meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把消息渠道（如 Telegram、Slack）接到代理组，管理隔离级别，添加新渠道组。它会先检查当前配置，再指导你完成渠道注册或重新配置。
howto.when: 当你在添加渠道后、初始设置中，或需要重新配置现有渠道时，Claude 会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Telegram 群接到我的代理组
say.note: 会询问隔离级别并执行注册命令。

say.text: 检查一下当前渠道配置，看看哪些还没接上
say.note: 会读取数据库并列出状态。

say.text: 我想添加一个新的 WhatsApp 群，同样接给这个代理
say.note: 会走添加渠道组流程，可能要求配对码。

howto.what_en: Claude wires messaging channels (e.g. Telegram, Slack) to agent groups, manages isolation levels, and adds channel groups. It first assesses current state, then guides you through registering or reconfiguring channels.
howto.when_en: When adding a new channel, during initial setup, or when reconfiguring existing channels, Claude takes over.

say_en.text: Wire this Telegram group to my agent group.
say_en.note: It asks isolation level and runs the register command.

say_en.text: Check the current channel config and show what's not wired.
say_en.note: It reads the DB and lists the status.

say_en.text: Add a new WhatsApp group and wire it to this agent as well.
say_en.note: It may ask for a pairing code for the new group.
